name: Hammershout the Elder
summary: During the Lunar Festival, you meet Hammershout the Elder in Stormwind's Park and honor the old races with a ceremonial token.

sections.title: Honoring Ancient Blood
sections.body: Ancestor spirits walk Azeroth for the festival, offering wisdom and blessings to travelers who pay their respects. In Stormwind's Park, Hammershout the Elder recalls the ancient races who walked the land before today's kingdoms rose.

sections.title: Tokens of Ancestral Reverence
sections.body: Hammershout the Elder asks only that you acknowledge the past. He is relieved and grateful when people still honor the old races. In return, he gives you a ceremonial token, binding the living to the spirits who came before.

faq.answer: Hammershout the Elder is an ancestral spirit who appears during the Lunar Festival. In Stormwind, he honors Azeroth's ancient lineages and offers blessings and tokens to those who pay their respects.

faq.q: Where can Elder Hammershout be found?
faq.answer: During the Lunar Festival, you can find Hammershout the Elder in Stormwind's Park district.

faq.q: Why does Elder Hammershout mention the 'olden races'?
faq.answer: Hammershout the Elder speaks of the olden races because the Lunar Festival honors ancient peoples and traditions. They shaped Azeroth before modern settlements rose.

faq.q: What token does Elder Hammershout offer?
faq.answer: Hammershout the Elder offers a Coin of Ancestry, a ceremonial token from the Lunar Festival spirits to travelers who seek out elders and pay their respects.

faq.q: Can Horde adventurers speak with Elder Hammershout?
faq.answer: Yes. Horde travelers can speak with Hammershout the Elder, though Stormwind is the Alliance capital.

faq.q: Is this encounter tied to an active holiday?
faq.answer: Hammershout the Elder appears during the annual Lunar Festival and grants blessings before returning to the spirit realm.

angles.text: In Stormwind's Park, Hammershout the Elder reminds you that Azeroth's history reaches back before the human kingdom.
When you visit Stormwind's Park, Hammershout the Elder recalls reverence, peace, and the world's shared ancestral past.
To reach Hammershout the Elder, you enter Stormwind and make your way to the Park, a daring journey for a Horde pilgrim.
